units.text: Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take on the house as a project of your own, and the effort shows in every corner of it.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart made use of all of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household was a working concern, a partner and you building something with real weight. You left that chapter with a home that stood firmly on its own.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart takes it in gladly. Since your mid-thirties the household has become a place of making things work, with a partner beside you and more to manage each year. Your home grows solid around the plans you see through, one fixed thing at a time.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties the household asks for steady effort, with bills to meet and plans to fund beside your own. You share the jobs with someone close and get your evenings back.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was working against it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household kept you running, with costs to cover and plans that pulled in different directions. With a partner's steadiness to lean on, you learned to measure a week by what you finished.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart pulls the other way. Since your mid-thirties, home has run on errands and accounts, with every week asking you to fetch and fix and pay. Each job you let wait gives you back an evening, and the house runs no worse for it.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart still wants it. From your late forties new chances keep coming within reach, and the people after you bring many of them. You pick the few that matter and make them pay off.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is still eager for it. Since your late forties what you built has kept paying out, with fresh plans brought in by the people after you. You stay busy by choice, which is a different thing from being kept busy.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, in a chart that works against it. From your late forties what you have built asks to be tended, along with requests and ventures the people after you set going. You take it task by task, and the rest keeps until tomorrow.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, though your chart leans away from it. Since your late forties there has been a steady pull to manage, to keep accounts and settle what the people after you ask for. You keep a walk before the day's requests begin, and that quiet hour holds the rest together.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart welcomed every bit of it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties there was always something within reach, a chance to earn or a door that opened when you pushed. You came out of those years sure of your own hands.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart has been waiting for it. Since your late teens, work and study have kept handing you things to take hold of, a first wage or a venture that pays its way. You reach a little further each year, and the misses teach as much as the catches.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart wanted less of it. Between your late teens and your mid-thirties work came with too many openings at once, each one asking for a piece of you. A friend with a level head steadied you, and from them you learned which chances to let pass.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, more than your chart can use. Since your late teens there has been more to chase than you could catch, offers and side ventures and people who want a share. You get through by finishing what you started before saying yes to the next thing.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart was hungry for it. The home you grew up in gave you things to do and things to reach for. You learned young that effort gets you what you want.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Action, into a chart that did better without it. Your first home was busy with getting and keeping, and the grown-ups around you counted every effort. You grew up restless, and an older relative's patience taught you to slow your reach.
In Career, this chapter favours work that pays as it goes over work that pays at the end, and you keep more than one thing running at once.
In Career, this chapter favours finishing what you started over taking on the next offer, but each thing you finish is worth two you begin.
At home, this chapter favours shared plans over private ones, and you run the household as a joint venture.
At home, this chapter favours plain help over money, and what you give by showing up counts for more than what you pay.
In Growth, this chapter favours learning by doing over learning from a book, and what you pick up comes from tasks set just beyond your reach.
In Growth, this chapter favours one thing done slowly and well over a fresh start each season, but you grow by staying with what you already have.
In Health, this chapter favours moving through the day over saving yourself for later, but you have the most energy when your hands are busy with something real.
In Health, this chapter favours a slower pace over one more errand, but you find your appetite once the list stops growing.
In Love, this chapter favours practical care over fine words, but you show love best through the things you fix and pay for.
In Love, this chapter favours evenings together over plans for more, and you find a partner values your time above anything you bring home.
In your thinking, this chapter favours a problem you can solve today over a question with no end, and the ideas you trust are the ones you can test within a week.
In your thinking, this chapter favours an unplanned afternoon over a longer list, and what you see most clearly arrives when nothing is asked of you.
With friends, this chapter favours saying yes to the invitation over staying in, and the people you meet in passing open doors you could not reach alone.
With friends, this chapter favours a few close people over a wide circle, and you keep the ones who ask nothing of your money.
In Wealth, this chapter favours putting money to work over letting it sit, and what you plant pays back more than what you save.
In Wealth, this chapter favours a clear budget over a bigger income, but you rest easier once every bill has a name and a date.
This chapter rewards reaching. You are paid back for every offer you take up and put to use straight away.
This chapter spreads you thin. You hold your ground when your own strength comes first and the chase comes second.
This decade brings {el} and steady returns on the care you have put in. You build the kind of security that lets you stop counting.
This decade brings {el} through chances that open sideways, a neighbour's idea or a skill someone wants to pay for. You find money and company in places you had never thought to look.
These years brought {el}, with chores and errands that earned you a coin or two. You learned that effort paid, and the feeling stayed with you.
These years brought {el} through trips, outings and things to explore beyond the front door. You came home with pockets full of finds and plans for the next outing.
This decade brings {el} as what you built starting to pay you back. You spend with a clear head and still have enough left to be generous.
This decade brings {el} through practical chances, a move, a sale or a plan with friends that takes shape. You say yes to the ones you can hold in both hands.
These years brought {el} as practical plans that came good, a house put in order and savings that held. You took hold of what you had built and made it work for you.
These years brought {el} through projects you could finish with your own hands, a kitchen rebuilt or a garden laid out. You liked seeing the result each evening and started the next one gladly.

This decade brings {el} and the Action your chart wants, with plans for the house that come together and money that goes where you send it. What you built keeps its value. You take on the projects you choose and see each one through.
These years brought {el} and a job that paid for effort. You learned to handle money, and it stayed handled.
These years brought {el} as a stretch of ventures and practical wins. You took hold of chances others passed over, and several of them paid.

This decade brings {el}, the Action your chart is hungry for, with work that pays and chances you can take hold of. Money comes in at a steady pace and practical life gets easier. Each year your reach goes a little further, and most of what you gain stays yours.
This decade brings {el} as demands that pull you in several directions at once. You keep your footing by taking one task at a time and finishing it.
This decade brings {el} with more to earn and more to spend, and every gain costs an hour. Choosing a slower pace carries you, and you turn down offers that cost more than they give.
These years brought {el} as clubs, plans and errands that pulled you different ways at once. With a close friend beside you, you learned to choose one thing at a time.
These years brought {el} into a busy home where the grown-ups were always working and counting. You found ease with a cousin or a close friend, though you grew capable sooner than a child needs to.
This decade brings {el} as offers, schemes and calls on your money from every direction. You say no to most of them and keep your days for what you want.
This decade brings {el} as a busy house, with things to fix, move and pay for at once. You set your own pace with them, and nothing in the house suffers for it.
These years brought {el} in the shape of repairs, errands and accounts that never seemed to shorten. You got through it by doing one job each morning and leaving the rest for the next day.
These years brought {el} through money matters that wanted your attention, a house to keep up and costs that crept upward. You shared the paperwork with someone close and kept your evenings free.

This decade brings {el}, an Action that works against your chart, with a house to manage and money the people after you lean on. Each week brings another bill, another repair or another request. You get through it with help from someone close and a slower pace that lets some things wait.
These years brought {el} as bills, offers and chances that all wanted a piece of your time. You got through by saying no, and by dropping whatever did not matter.
These years brought {el} and the weight of practical life, a home to run and costs that kept climbing. What held you up was a friend who pitched in without being asked.

This decade brings {el}, more Action than your chart can use, with money to manage and a household that leans on it. Each gain asks more work of you than it asks of others. Someone close who splits the chores carries you, and you keep a clear count of what your life costs to run.
Two things on the go|one slow project
One piece of work finished|two half started
Doing up the house together|each doing their own
Turning up to help|paying someone to
A task a size too big|a book on the subject
Getting better at what you have|adding something new
A day on your feet|a morning in bed
A slow afternoon|a list that keeps growing
New plans as a pair|the usual weekend
An evening with no plans|another shared project
A problem you can fix by hand|an idea on paper
One decision at a time|ten open questions
Friends who do business|friends who just chat
A walk with a friend|a networking event
Money from two places|more from one
Clearing a debt|signing for a new one
{el} brings Action for a whole year, an even weight on your chart's practical side. You earn and spend at your usual rate, with no big leap to chase and no gap to fill.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, and your practical life keeps level. What you earn, fix and arrange runs as it did last year, without a rush or a shortfall.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, reach your chart welcomes. Your effort pays back promptly, as practical plans move at the speed you set.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, and the reach holds. A plan you started last year pays its way, which gives you the footing to widen it with care.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, more chasing than your chart can use. There are more tasks than hours to give them, but you have a short list and the right to say no.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, an effort that works against your chart. You carry last year's list into this one, with the freedom to drop what does not matter.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, a reach your chart runs short of. Each effort you make comes back as something you can hold, an offer, a payment or a plan that moves.
{el} brings Action for a second year running, a reach your chart wants. What you opened last year turns into steady gains, with more of each one staying in your hands.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, after years in which your chart went without it. From your mid-thirties, a partner stands with you on level ground and the household gives your strength a base. You meet the years of home on firmer feet, and the floor under you is your own.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, when your chart ran short of it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties a partner met you as an equal, and the household made you sturdier. You learned to lean on yourself first and on others by choice.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart is short of it. Since your mid-thirties, a partner has backed you as a true equal and home has become the place your strength gathers. You walk out of your own door each morning surer of where you stand.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, though your chart is already flush with it. From your mid-thirties two strong wills share one household, and a partner who feels like an equal is also a rival. With an evening to yourself each week to cool off, you get further at home by giving way first.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, to a chart that held too much of it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties home was a place of strong wills and long standoffs, and you rarely backed down first. You got through on an hour's walk before each row set hard, and on cooling off before you spoke.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, in a chart that is already crowded with it. Since your mid-thirties, the household has felt like a contest of wills, with a partner as stubborn as you. Time apart for your own interests cools it down, and you are learning that yielding at home costs you nothing.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, with a chart that has long gone without it. From your late forties the people after you stand at your side, and what you have built gives you a firm floor. You grow surer of yourself with every year of it.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, and your chart has been hungry for it. Since your late forties, the people after you have stood behind you and what you built has started to hold its own weight. You stop asking permission for what is plainly yours to decide.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, on top of a chart already heavy with it. From your late forties you hold tight to what you have built, and the people after you want a hand on it too. Once you say no to the small fights, you keep your strength for the few that count.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, when your chart already overflows with it. Since your late forties you have guarded what you built closely, even from the people after you who want a hand in it. Passing the work into younger hands spends that strength well, and you are finding that a lighter grip holds more.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, the strength your chart had always lacked. From your late teens to your mid-thirties study and work put you among equals, and friends lent you the nerve you had been missing. You left that chapter able to stand up for yourself.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, at a time your chart is low on it. Since your late teens, friends and peers have stood beside you, and every rival has made you stronger rather than smaller. You stand your ground without first checking who agrees.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, for a chart already brimming with it. Between your late teens and mid-thirties friends doubled as rivals and you competed for every piece of work. With time alone at the end of each hard week, you grew tougher and choosier about your fights.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, into a chart that already runs over with it. Since your late teens, work has asked you to prove yourself, and you push harder than any job needs. On the one slow day you keep each week, you learn where that strength is worth spending.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, your own energy, when your chart was thin on it. Up to fifteen, children your age gave you someone to keep up with, in games you had to push your way into. You came out of that first home steadier on your own feet than you began.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, more of your own energy than your chart could hold. Through your school years you fought for your place among the children around you and rarely gave an inch. With an older relative who listened when you dug in, you learned to stand alone without standing against everyone.
In Career, this chapter favours a seat at the table over a place in the queue, and the footing you find comes from people who work at your level.
In Career, this chapter favours making something over beating someone, but you do your best work when the effort goes into the thing itself.
At home, this chapter favours saying what you need over keeping everyone happy, and the place you claim at the table stays yours.
At home, this chapter favours letting someone else be right over winning the point, but you keep more peace than any argument would win you.
In Growth, this chapter favours hard tests over safe lessons, and you come out of each one with a firmer sense of yourself.
In Growth, this chapter favours a skill you build quietly over a test of strength, and what you learn without an opponent stays with you.
In Health, this chapter favours building stamina over spending it, but you gain strength from steady training more than from bursts of effort.
In Health, this chapter favours hard exercise over sitting still, and the days you burn off the extra force are the days you are easiest to live with.
In Love, this chapter favours standing beside a partner over standing behind them, and you grow surer of your own place in the pair.
In Love, this chapter favours meeting a partner halfway over holding your line, but you soften once you stop counting who gave way.
In your thinking, this chapter favours your own read of a situation over a vote of everyone you know, and the decisions you back alone hold up.
In your thinking, this chapter favours hearing the other side out over defending your first answer, but you think more clearly once you can be wrong out loud.
With friends, this chapter favours peers who challenge you over people who admire you, and you gain nerve from every friendly contest.
With friends, this chapter favours a shared meal over a friendly contest, and what you give up in winning comes back as company.
In Wealth, this chapter favours money you can say you made over money that comes as a gift, and the sums you trust are the ones you can trace to your own effort.
In Wealth, this chapter favours an account in your own name over a pot shared with friends, but you keep more when no one else can draw on it.
This chapter tops up a strength your chart has always run short of. You get the most from it among equals, in teams and contests where you can measure yourself.
This chapter fills you with more of your own strength than you can store. You do best when you spend it, on hard work and on people who need what you know.
This decade brings {el} and a sturdier sense of yourself. You stand by your own judgement at work and at home, and approval matters less to you.
This decade brings {el} through friends and rivals who keep you sharp. You compete in the open and win more often than you lose.
These years brought {el}, a strength your chart was short of, with games and teams at school. You learned early that you could hold your own among other children.
These years brought {el} through children your age who wanted the same toys and the same turn. You learned to stand up for your share, and you never quite stopped.
This decade brings {el} as stamina you can build, a daily walk that grows longer by the month. You hold your own on the hill and in an argument.
This decade brings {el} through old friends and new ones who meet you as an equal. You take your seat where the family decisions get made and say your piece.
These years brought {el} into your stride and your say, a strength your chart had wanted. You walked further, decided for yourself and asked fewer people for leave.
These years brought {el} through friends your own age who kept pace with you. You held your place at the table among equals and spoke up when it counted.

This decade brings {el}, the backbone your chart has wanted, felt in a steadier stride. You take the hill without stopping and hold your ground when the people after you disagree. You decide for yourself where you live, how fast you go and whom you keep close.
These years brought {el} and the company of equals, colleagues and friends who matched your pace. You found a firmness in yourself that had been missing before.
These years brought {el}, a stretch when you stopped waiting for permission. You struck out on your own terms and held your position against people who doubted you.

This decade brings {el}, your own energy, and your chart has gone short of it. You stand straighter at work and among peers and hold ground you once gave away. You pay for it by sharing credit with equals, and it is a price worth paying.
This decade brings {el} beyond what your chart needs, a grip that holds on harder than the moment asks. You spend the surplus on a long walk each evening, before it can turn into a quarrel.
This decade brings {el} with a habit of holding on to your own way at home. You find a slower answer eases it, and a draw is worth more to you than a win.
These years brought more {el} than a child could hold, and every game turned into a contest. Hours outdoors on your own burned off the surplus, and you learned to win without a fight.
These years brought {el} and a stubborn streak that pushed against the grown-ups at home. You found that an hour on your own cooled you faster than any argument won.
This decade brings {el} with the urge to carry every load and win every point. You burn off the surplus with an early walk and save your strength for the tasks you choose.
This decade brings {el} as a stubborn streak with friends and with the people after you. You let more quarrels go once you keep an hour each day for yourself.
These years brought {el} piled onto a chart already running over, with a habit of lifting every heavy thing yourself. You learned to let someone close take the other end of the load.
These years brought {el} as a stubborn grip on how things were done at home. Once you slowed your pace, you let the people after you do things their own way.

This decade brings {el} through a firm hand on how home and family should run, a surplus your chart does better without. The people after you push back, and every small choice turns into a stand. With an hour to yourself each morning, you meet the day readier to let little things pass.
These years brought {el} to spare, and peers who wanted the same things as you. You kept level by finishing what you started and letting the results argue for you.
These years brought {el} into a chart already full of it, and you went it alone more than you needed to. You learned to share the load once someone close offered a hand and you took it.

This decade brings {el}, a surplus of your own energy, and it makes you stubborn with your equals. People at work want the same ground you do, and every meeting turns into a test of will. What carries you is time alone at the start of each day, before anyone asks anything of you.
Work you own outright|work someone else signs off
The work itself|who gets the credit
Saying what you need|fitting round others
Letting a point drop|winning every one
Doing it yourself|waiting for help
Beating your own mark|beating someone else's
Effort you can keep up|one big burst
Sweating it off|bottling it up
Holding your own view|agreeing to please
Letting the other choose|always choosing first
Your own conclusions|what everyone else thinks
Checking with someone you trust|going with your gut
Friends who match your pace|friends who carry you
Cheering others on|keeping score
Paying your own way|someone else picking up the bill
Separate savings|a kitty with friends
{el} brings Body for a whole year, your own strength at an even level for your chart. You hold your own with equals at your usual pitch, neither pushing for ground nor giving it up.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, and your strength stays level. Your stamina and your nerve keep last year's measure, with nothing to prove and nothing to hold back.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, strength your chart already runs over with. You meet every exchange as a contest of wills, though time alone and letting a small point go stay open to you.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, strength piled on strength. Each old rivalry you thought had cooled flares up, though a slower pace and help from someone close are yours to call on.
{el} brings Body for a whole year, a strength your chart runs short of. You stand your ground more easily, as equals begin to treat you as one of them.
{el} brings Body for a second year running, a strength your chart wants. Equals take you seriously now, while the place you held back from last year opens to you.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is eager for it. From your mid-thirties home becomes a place of good food and music, with a partner who enjoys you at your liveliest. You make the household a warm place to come back to.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart blossomed under it. From your mid-thirties to your late forties home was lively, with a partner who laughed at your stories and a table set for guests. You came out of it knowing how to make a house feel like yours.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is warmed by it. Since your mid-thirties, home has been full of cooking, laughter and things you made with a partner. You let yourself enjoy it all in these years without first earning it.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, an energy your chart does better without. From your mid-thirties your tongue is quick at home, and a partner hears more of your opinions than they asked for. You find the warmth comes back on a slow walk after dinner, when you listen more than you talk.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, in a chart that worked better without it. Between your mid-thirties and late forties you said what you thought at home and spent on whatever pleased you. Long quiet evenings wore the urge down, and you came away choosing your words with more care.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties, appetite and opinion have filled the house, and a partner has borne the brunt of your restlessness. An hour of quiet each evening settles it, and you are learning to let them have the last word.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart is ready for all of it. From your late forties, there is time and skill to make what is in your head, and the people after you learn by watching. You stop saving your ideas for later.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart sings with it. Since your late forties you have taught, performed or made things for the people after you, and they carry your style. You make things for the pleasure of it, with nothing left to prove.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, one that works against your chart. From your late forties you hold opinions on how the people after you live, and you voice them freely. With an hour alone each day to cool your views, you find they listen better when you say less.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, more than your chart can use. Since your late forties you have spent freely on pleasures and told the people after you exactly what you think. With a night between a thought and its saying, you find your words carry further when there are fewer of them.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart came alive with it. From your late teens to your mid-thirties you made things, spoke up and found friends who liked your work. You came out of that chapter with a voice people recognised.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has been waiting for exactly this. Since your late teens, what you make has found listeners at work and among friends who ask what comes next. You show your work before it is perfect, and it lands anyway.

Your Rising Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, against the grain of your chart. Between your late teens and mid-thirties you spoke first, spent freely and chafed at every rule you had not written. Finishing one thing before you started the next carried you, and you left those years knowing which fights deserved your voice.

Your Rising Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart has more than it can spend. Since your late teens your voice has outrun your position, and the people in charge have not always enjoyed it. You are learning that finished work speaks louder than talk, and that a day of silence before you object keeps your place.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart was glad of the outlet. Before you turned sixteen there were drawings, songs and stories, and the grown-ups at home clapped for every one of them. You came out of childhood sure that your voice was worth hearing.

Your Early Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Expression, into a chart that pulled against it. As a child you talked back, tested every rule and wanted everything at once. With an older relative who heard you out before answering, you learned when to speak and when to wait.
In Career, this chapter favours work with your name on it over work that disappears into the whole, and what you make yourself gets you noticed.
In Career, this chapter favours one piece finished over three begun, but you are trusted most for the work you hand in quietly.
At home, this chapter favours cooking and making things together over keeping the place tidy, and the touches you add make the house feel lived in.
At home, this chapter favours a kind word over a sharp one, and you keep the household calm by holding back the first reply.
In Growth, this chapter favours making something of your own over collecting certificates, and what you show to others teaches you the most.
In Growth, this chapter favours slow work out of sight over quick display, but you go further with one thing kept back until it is right.
In Health, this chapter favours good food and play over strict routines, and you recover your energy through the things you enjoy.
In Health, this chapter favours a steady appetite over feasts, but you keep your energy on evenings when you talk less and stop sooner.
In Love, this chapter favours laughing with a partner over keeping things serious, and the affection you show openly is returned in kind.
In Love, this chapter favours hearing a partner out over making your point, and you win more warmth by asking than by telling.
In your thinking, this chapter favours ideas you can make real over ideas you only hold, and you think best with a pen in your hand.
In your thinking, this chapter favours one finished idea over ten half-formed ones, but you give your best thought the time it needs to ripen.
With friends, this chapter favours a lively table over a quiet evening in, and you become the one who gets everyone talking.
With friends, this chapter favours a long walk with one person over a big night with many, but you are trusted more when you share less.
In Wealth, this chapter favours earning from a skill over earning by the hour, and what you enjoy doing starts to pay.
In Wealth, this chapter favours buying once over buying often, but you keep more when a treat waits until the end of the month.
This chapter opens an outlet your chart has long been short of. You gain most when you finish what you start and let other people see it.
This chapter loosens your tongue and your appetite more than your chart can use. You keep your standing when you wait before you answer and speak once.
This decade brings {el}, the outlet your chart is short of. You say what you think at the moment you think it, and the words come out whole.
This decade brings {el} and a skill ready to be shown, with people keen to learn it from you. You teach, make or perform, and you are paid in attention as well as thanks.
These years brought {el}, with drawing, music or games you made up yourself. You found something you were good at and showed it to anyone who would look.
These years brought {el} and a louder voice at school, in class and in the playground. Someone in your first home enjoyed your stories, and you learned that you were worth hearing.
This decade brings {el} and the pleasure of showing someone younger how a thing is made. You teach with your hands as much as your words, and the lessons stick.
This decade brings {el} as an appetite for new tastes, new places and an evening out without a reason. You say yes to the invitation and come home with a story to tell.
These years brought {el} as time to make things for pleasure, a garden, a quilt or a tune at the piano. You made what you liked and gave much of it away.
